notes.title: 2024.11.13 Game Update
notes.content:
This is a moderate level update before the game's release, mainly including the following content:
1. Bug fixes
2. Optimization and update of scenery on both sides of the runway
3. Parkour Endless Mode Obstacle Playability Optimization Update
4. Playability and UI optimization updates for various mini games
5. Update some art resources such as icons, avatar frames, score level icons, etc
Above, I hope you like it. Thank you
